result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback position: it limits the restriction to Deerskin Products, removes the open-ended similar-product and similar-company language, applies only during the term and no longer than 12 months from the Effective Date, and expressly carves out internal development and acquisitions. It preserves HDI’s Deerskin-brand exclusivity and the surrounding term and termination provisions. The edits are appropriately targeted and professionally drafted, though deleting the restriction entirely would have achieved the preferred position.
